## Rationale

References to `se-workflow` inside the adaptive-artifacts repo (AGENTS.md, README) are extension-repo edits. They follow the adaptive-artifacts change gate: capture there and apply only with approval. This phase updates every reference in the affidavit (ex–se-workflow) tree and Landing includes the AA follow-up as a human stop, not a silent mid-task AA patch.

## Counter-argument

Patching AA docs from this session would keep all public text consistent in one sitting, but it violates the extension change gate and risks unapproved edits in that store.
